description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of a dataset categorized by the number of matches, displaying a total of seven distinct slices. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, category labels are positioned just outside the perimeter of each corresponding slice, while both the percentage and the raw count (enclosed in parentheses) are displayed directly inside the segments. Visually, the slices are arranged in descending numerical order based on their labels, progressing clockwise starting from the top. The largest segment, labeled "6 Matches," is colored in a muted dark blue-grey and accounts for 27.2% (8006) of the total. Continuing clockwise, the slice labeled "5" is a medium blue-grey representing 10.4% (3043), followed by "4" in a lighter blue-grey at 6.2% (1810). The next slice, labeled "3," is a muted brown-grey making up 6.8% (2002). The segment labeled "2" is a light olive-grey and represents 22.4% (6583), followed by "1" in a medium olive-grey at 13.8% (4046). Finally, the slice labeled "0" is a darker olive-grey, comprising 13.3% (3910) of the chart. None of the slices are visually emphasized through exploding, offsetting, or bolding.
